name: ai.councilof/gspc
description: Dated AI measurements and signed evidence over MCP. Read-only tools: read the GSPC board and one axis, verify a signed measurement card or capsule, check Merkle inclusion, list published measurements about an endpoint, read census snapshots. Every answer carries its state (VALID, INVALID, UNCHECKABLE, UNMEASURED). Free verification; never certification.
